can_proceed_with_assumptions.description: True when the user may skip the set and let the agent decide.

message.description: One or two sentences that introduce the questions.

title.description: A short title for the card, such as `Two things before I draft`.

BriefQuestion.description: One question the agent asks the user.

allow_other.description: True to offer an `Other` choice with a text field.

id.description: A short id unique in the set, such as `platform`.

kind.description:
How the user answers. `type` is accepted as an alias when a model
names the field that way.

options.description: The choices for a select question. Empty for text questions.

rationale.description: Why the answer changes the design. Shown under the question.

required.description:
True when the user must answer or skip. False when an empty
answer is fine.

QuestionKind.description: How the user answers a question.

QuestionOption.description: One preset answer for a select question.

label.description: The text the user sees, such as `Mobile app`.
